panels.general_description: Close-up color photograph of a round, pink-red raised skin lesion on a cheek of a child, with part of an eyelid and eyelashes at the upper left and dark hair at the lower right.
panels.detailed_description: A portrait-orientation color photograph of the skin of one side of the face. A single round to oval, dome-shaped nodule with a pink-red color is near the center, redder and darker toward its lower part and paler pink with a glossy highlight toward its upper part. Fine thin red vessel lines are visible on and around the nodule, and its border looks fairly sharp against the surrounding skin. The surrounding skin is light tan and smooth with fine short hairs, and no other lesion is visible in the field. The upper left corner shows the closed or lowered upper eyelid with eyelashes and a few small yellowish crusts or flakes near the lashes. The lower right edge shows dark scalp or head hair. There is no ruler, scale, arrow, panel letter, text, date or label in the image, so the size is not measurable from the picture.

visual.general_description: Four-panel microscopy figure: a stained high-power field (A) and three brown immunostained narrow tissue sections labeled CD4 (B), CD3 (C) and PD1 (D).
visual.detailed_description: Figure 2 is a horizontal row of four panels. Panel A is a high-power field densely packed with small dark purple-blue nuclei on a violet-pink background. Panels B, C and D are narrow vertical tissue sections on pale gray backgrounds labeled CD4, CD3 and PD1 at their lower right; B and C are stained diffusely brown and D is only faintly stained. Panel letters A to D are printed at the upper left of each panel.

panels.general_description: Purple-blue stained tissue field densely filled with small dark nuclei, with panel letter A at the upper left.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A is a high-power stained microscopy field filling the left quarter of the figure, with a black letter A at the upper left. The field is densely packed with small dark purple-blue nuclei, mostly oval or slightly elongated and similar in size, on a lighter violet-pink background with a few pale gaps. Cell borders and cytoplasm are not distinguishable and no distinct structure, gland or epidermal surface is visible. No scale bar, magnification text or stain name is printed in the pixels.
